Cyclic structures:
- Cyclobutanol: cyclic C4H7-OH
- Methyloxetane: CH3-C3H5O (3-membered ring with oxygen)
- Tetrahydrofuran: C4H8O (5-membered ring with oxygen)

I think I miscounted. The correct cyclic structures are:
